notes.title: Update to build 13172349
notes.content:
1. You can see the name of the user you killed. 
2. Displays an error pop-up when the connection is lost during the game.
3. Fixed a small bug.
4. The survival count of the in-game leaderboard is now displayed correctly.

notes.title: Start supporting the leaderboard
notes.content:
1. Server Ranking Leaderboard: If you press the lower right leaderboard button on the first screen, you can see the total score ranking of users who started counting today. 
2. Steam Leaderboard: Supports leaderboard for as many kills as possible in one game.
